chunks: Dārim ibn Qubayṣa ibn Nahshal, Abū al-Ḥasan, al-Sāyiḥ. Narrated from al-Riḍā (peace be upon him). His ḥadīth is not familiar and is not relied upon.

key_terms.الصَّايِحُ: al-Sāyiḥ (the wanderer or one who travels for knowledge)

ai.seo_question: Who is Dārim ibn Qubayṣa al-Sāyiḥ and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry from the book of weak narrators (Kitab al-Du'afa) identifies Dārim ibn Qubayṣa as a narrator of Imam al-Riḍā (peace be upon him). It notes that his narrations are not widely known (la yu'annas) and he is not considered reliable (la yuthaqqahu) for establishing hadith.
